text:
```yaml
name: Analyze and Package

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      ref:
        required: true
        type: string
    secrets:
      GITHUB_TOKEN:
        required: true

jobs:
  analyze:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ inputs.ref }}

      - name: Setup PowerShell
        uses: actions/setup-powershell@v2
        with:
          version: '7.4'

      - name: Install dpkg-dev
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y dpkg-dev

      - name: Build the PowerShell project
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          Import-Module ./build.psm1
          Build-Project

      - name: Build DEB package
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          Import-Module ./tools/packaging/packaging.psm1
          Build-DebPackage

      - name: Run package validation tests
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          Import-Module ./test/packaging/linux/package-validation.tests.ps1
          Run-PackageValidationTests

      - name: Run packaging tests
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          Import-Module ./test/packaging/linux/packaging.tests.ps1
          Run-PackagingTests
```
